text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you'll be all right? Ever since you were little, you've been flubb'n stuff when it matters most.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mooom! I'll be fine! I'm not a kid anymore, okay?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text: Ah… Hehe, yes, I know, I know. You're no longer a child… You're a stupendous Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mom…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe! That's right! Keep your eyes on me and you're gonna see even more stupendous running!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So, anyway! I was hoping you could train me to nab the win when things really come down to the wire!
choice_data_list: You got it! Let's do this!

text_block_list.text: Hey, before you start training, un momento, por favor!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: E-El?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: As I'm sure you know, I'm going to become the strongest Umamusume in the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But if I wanna do that, I'll have to defeat the one who made me taste bitter defeat—and that's you, Spe!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And that's why I was thinking I could be your training partner!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: There's no point in beating you if you're all weak and slow, after all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So it'll be better for both of us if you get even stronger!
Now, now, El. ♪ It's not fair to cut in line.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You're not the only one seeking a rematch with Spe, you know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, but would you mind my joining you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There are few feats more impressive than besting the best racer in Japan, you see.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoooa, looks like we all have the same idea. But please, don't let me interrupt your conversation.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I feel like I could get a lot more out of this by just listening from the sidelines anyway. ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You guys…
choice_data_list: Well, Spe? What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (It's thanks to everyone here that I was able to get stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (I was capable of moving forward because I had them.)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (And with them by my side, I'm sure I'll be able to reach even greater heights!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …Okay, let's all run together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I want to keep running with you guys forever and ever. And I think that's because…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I finally have what I longed for and ran for—the title of best racer in all of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Sounds like you're already confident you'll win. Or at the very least, that you're ready for a fight.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, let's just hope you don't regret underestimating us.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh… That is just what I was hoping to hear! Today, you are going to see a toootally different side to us!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer, could you count down for us, please?
choice_data_list: Sure! On your marks… Get set… Go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At my signal, Special Week and her rivals start tearing down the track together.
